BOTS.TITLE: Workflows
BOTS.DESCRIPTION: Create and manage automated conversation flows. Design visual workflows or set up webhook-based bots, then assign them to your inboxes.

SELECTOR.TITLE: Choose how to add a workflow
SELECTOR.VISUAL_BOT_DESC: Design conversation flows visually with a drag-and-drop editor. No coding required.
SELECTOR.WEBHOOK_BOT_DESC: Connect an external bot service via webhook URL for full control over the conversation logic.

BOTS.DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete this workflow? This cannot be undone.
BOTS.ASSIGN_SUCCESS: Workflow assigned to inbox. It will now handle incoming messages.
BOTS.ASSIGN_ERROR: Failed to assign workflow. Make sure the workflow is published first.
BOTS.UNASSIGN_ERROR: Failed to remove workflow from inbox.
BOTS.EMPTY: No workflows yet. Create one to get started with automated conversations.
BOTS.NOT_CONFIGURED_HELP: Set TYPEBOT_BUILDER_URL and TYPEBOT_API_TOKEN to enable the workflow builder. The API token must be created inside Typebot (Settings → My account → API tokens), not an arbitrary string.
BOTS.POPUP_BLOCKED: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
BOTS.BUILDER_URL_MISSING: TYPEBOT_BUILDER_URL is not set on the server. Add it to the deployment environment and redeploy.

CARD.PUBLISHED_DESC: Live and ready to handle conversations
CARD.DRAFT_DESC: Edit and publish to start using this workflow
